One FBA stock. Two sales channels. Zero new inventory.

Your Amazon FBA stock is sitting in Amazon's warehouse — but you're only selling it on Amazon. That's leaving money on the table.

With Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment (MCF) in India, you can sell that same stock on your own website, Instagram DMs, WhatsApp — anywhere. Order comes in, you enter it manually in Seller Central, and Amazon picks, packs, and ships it for you. Fees start as low as ₹59 per order (varies by size and weight).

No second stockroom. No new inventory. Just a new revenue channel from stock you already have.

This is how to build a D2C sales channel without touching logistics — perfect for Indian sellers who are 100% dependent on Amazon right now.
